svg.title: Scene 2A: room, phone, and scrolling comments
svg.desc: A cream living room with an enlarged espresso phone centered on the frame and a reclining man on a sage sofa lower-left beneath colored shelves.
svg.metadata: Editable 9:16 scene. Important text stays above y=1248. The reclining person, sofa, and their shadow use the lower illustration-only band; the bottom 20% remains background-only. The lower 15% may contain only the person, furniture, and other non-text illustration; the last 20% stays empty except for background.

g.data-role: phone remains within central text-safe area

text.tspan: Pacar gue tiap ada masalah suka ngilang.
Gue chat malam, pagi baru dibales
Padahal dia yang salah, malah marah
Kak, dia murung terus akhir-akhir ini.
